categories.main_business_segments: Chengdu Qushui Science and Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing and internet retail of high-quality, easy-to-install furniture and home textile products. The company focuses on smart sleep-related home products including smart electric beds, smart mattresses, intelligent heating blankets, and smart pillows. It also engages in new material research and development, software technology, and home furnishing design and sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes technology innovation, new material application, and standardization. It employs an outsourced production model, focusing on product design, R&D, and supply chain management. Core technologies include intelligent sensing, ergonomic design, and thermal management. The company has a three-tier R&D system covering basic research, applied development, and product transformation, with 287 active patents including 5 invention patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company targets young middle-class consumers seeking upgraded, comfortable sleep and home living solutions. Its products are sold mainly through online platforms such as Xiaomi Youpin, JD.com, and Tmall, serving individual consumers and B2B2C clients. The company also serves distributors and has a small offline sales presence. Key customers include major e-commerce platforms and related ecosystem partners.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Chengdu and branches in Ningbo and Hangzhou. It plans to expand internationally focusing on Europe, Southeast Asia, and Japan, leveraging its smart home product portfolio to penetrate these overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qushui operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It focuses on product design, R&D, and sales, while production is outsourced to external manufacturers. The company manages supply chain logistics, quality control, and inventory but does not own manufacturing facilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on intelligent sleep home products and AI integration, aiming to become an AI-enabled smart home enterprise. It plans to deepen collaboration with Xiaomi’s AI+ ecosystem, accelerate AI large model applications in sleep health, and expand its smart product line. R&D investment increased by 35.47% in 2024, focusing on smart electric beds, AI sleep aids, and smart home integration technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales via online retail channels including B2C and B2B2C e-commerce platforms. The company also uses distributor sales and limited offline sales. Revenue recognition follows delivery and receipt confirmation rules on e-commerce platforms, with deductions for returns and refunds.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Qushui positions itself as a leading internet-based smart sleep home brand in China, leveraging technology innovation and efficient online sales. It competes in the furniture and home textile manufacturing industry, focusing on smart home and sleep health niches. The company benefits from strong partnerships with Xiaomi and other major e-commerce platforms, differentiating itself through smart product innovation and digital marketing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 347.3 million, a 13.93% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 28.97 million, up 21.40%. The smart product segment accounted for over 40% of revenue, growing 36.32%. Cash flow from operations increased by 68.79%, and cash reserves including financial products totaled RMB 838 million. The company has 40 million shares outstanding and a net asset value of RMB 812 million.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qushui emphasizes technology-driven product innovation, high-quality materials, standardization, and cost-effectiveness. Its unique value lies in smart, easy-to-install home furniture and sleep products that integrate AI and IoT technologies to enhance user comfort and health. The company’s direct online sales model and agile supply chain enable rapid product iteration and competitive pricing, supported by strong brand recognition and digital marketing strategies.
